syllabus.clause: the 4.x line on Spark 4.x (4.4 supports Spark 4.0–4.2): Variant (shredding out of preview in 4.3), type widening, collations, identity and generated columns, geospatial types; Delta Kernel as the library that lets non-Spark engines (Flink, Trino, DuckDB, delta-rs) read and write Delta correctly; delta-rs as the Rust implementation.
